message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a framed canvas Halloween print. The question is whether it falls under 4911.91 (printed pictures), 9505.90 (festive articles), or 9701 (paintings).

Festive articles under heading 9505 cover articles for Halloween. CBP has often classified Halloween decorative wall art in 9505.90.6000 when the article is a decorative item used at Halloween. Printed canvas with glitter, framed, would otherwise go to 4911.91 or 4911.99. However, 9505 covers festive articles, and the description says it is intended for Halloween display. Many CBP rulings on Halloween framed canvas prints (for example, a "light-up canvas" for Halloween) classified them in 9505.90.6000, and I recall a ruling on a framed canvas print with glitter classified in 9505.90.6000. The explicit mention of Halloween use strongly suggests 9505.

HTSUS 9505.90.60 covers "Festive, carnival or other entertainment articles... other: other", and the 10-digit code is 9505.90.6000.

{"hts_code": "9505.90.6000", "reason": "The framed glitter-accented canvas print is a decorative article specifically designed for Halloween display, making it a festive article of heading 9505 rather than a printed picture of heading 4911."}
